name: memory-graph
description: Memória de projeto num vault Obsidian — escrita pelo obsidian CLI, recall semântico + travessia de [[links]] 100% on-device (fastembed + sqlite-vec), zero nuvem. Traz as skills memory-vault (protocolo diário) e memory-vault-setup (criação do vault + migração da memória legada).

args: set -euo pipefail; root=""; for c in "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; do if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -d "$c/memory_graph" ]; then root="$c"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$root" ]; then shopt -s nullglob; for cand in "$HOME"/.cursor/plugins/cache/*/memory-graph/*/ "$HOME"/.claude/plugins/cache/*/*/memory-graph/ "$HOME"/.claude/plugins/cache/*/*/plugins/memory-graph/; do if [ -d "${cand}memory_graph" ]; then root="${cand%/}"; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$root" ]; then echo "memory-graph MCP: plugin root not found" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec bash "$root/scripts/serve.sh"
